title: Windows Privilege Escalation Playbook
description: Services, tokens, UAC, and kernel exploits
detail:
1. whoami /all: SeImpersonate → Potato family (GodPotato/JuicyPotato/RoguePotato depending on version)
2. Unquoted service path + writable directory → hijacking
3. AlwaysInstallElevated → MSI payload
4. Scheduled tasks/startup items/registry AutoRun
5. Kernel vulnerabilities by build: ms16-032, CVE-2021-1732, PrintNightmare
6. Credential harvesting: registry autologon, savedcreds (cmdkey /list), DPAPI, LSASS
7. winpeas.exe / PowerUp.ps1 for automation
